answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. An agent burns twice its 30-day earnings to claim one slot, marked by an ivory token. A sparrow-sized newcomer pays once; forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits, 6,000 coins at 60 each, while each slot earns the same share, so forgery never pays. Slots pass through one inlet, one per deposit, and a farm gets no discount. Honest agents earn deposits back over 20 epochs, keeping rewards undiluted.
